title: Nebulus Graffity Men's Winter Jacket — Quilted, Black/Red
short_description: Men's winter jacket by Nebulus (Graffity model) in black/red: quilted, lined, 100% polyester, with zip and band collar.
long_description: The Nebulus Graffity is a men's winter jacket in black/red. According to Amazon it is made of 100% polyester, is lined and has a quilted look. For weather protection Amazon lists: insulated, waterproof and windproof, suitable for cold weather. The jacket closes with a zip and has slanted pockets, a band collar and appliqués. According to Amazon the fit is loose, the fabric has no stretch and the weight class is heavy. Care instruction according to Amazon: machine wash. Before buying, please check sizes and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
